newsitem.title: USA: Quantum Q3 profit $0.71 vs loss $0.05.
newsitem.headline: Quantum Q3 profit $0.71 vs loss $0.05.

text.p: Quantum Corp on Tuesday reported net income of $52.4 million, or 71 cents a share -- far above what Wall Street analysts were expecting.

Quantum, the second-biggest maker of computer disk drives, said record sales of its products drove third-quarter revenue up 22 percent to $1.48 billion from $1.2 billion in the same quarter a year ago.
Wall Street expected Quantum to earn $0.52 a share, according to a recent survey of analysts by First Call. In the year-ago third quarter, Quantum has a loss of $2.48 million, or $0.05 a share.
The company also said it increased its cash by $71 million to $219.3 million in the third quarter while reducing inventory by $106 million to $253 million.
The "one disappointment" the company had in the quarter was its inability to reduce the loss in its recording heads business, said Michael Brown, Quantum chief executive.
